description: Keyboard chord generator holding 25 chords of up to four notes each, recalled by index; the CHD-X expander adds four quantizers that snap pitches to the active chord

params.text: Steps the octave of that note of the chord up; the range runs from a dash through 0 to 9, and the dash takes that note out of the chord
Steps the octave of that note of the chord down; the range runs from a dash through 0 to 9, and the dash takes that note out of the chord
Selects which of the 25 stored chords is active
Overrides the GATE input and holds every gate output at 10V, so the chord sounds while it is being set up
Transposes the chord up one semitone, moving the octave values to match
Transposes the chord down one semitone, moving the octave values to match

inputs.text: Added to the INDEX knob to pick the chord, a semitone per chord: 0V is the first chord and 2V the twenty-fifth, matching the notes C4 to C6
A monophonic gate here fires the gate output of every active note at once; with a polyphonic gate, channel N drives the Nth note of the chord, which can be used to arpeggiate it

outputs.text: Pitch of that note of the chord
Gate for that note of the chord, taken from the GATE input or forced on by FORCE

notes: a key press sets one of the four notes of the chord, chosen by how far down the key it lands; the key is split into four bands, the top band setting the first note
FourView placed against the right edge shows the note names of the chord with no cables patched; where the CHD-X expander is also in use, FourView goes to the right of that expander
menu: Keypress monitoring — sounds the whole chord while a key is held with the left mouse button, and only the note pressed with the right button
Poly merge outputs into top note — folds the lower rows into the top row, whose CV and gate outputs become polyphonic; None, Second, Second and third, or Second, third and fourth
Copy chord (internal) and Paste chord (internal) — move a chord between index positions through a memory inside the module, keeping unused notes in place
Portable sequence — holds Copy chord, Paste chord, Copy chord as sequence, Paste sequence as chord, and Autostep after paste, for moving notes to and from other sequencers
Transpose — a slider moving the whole chord by a number of semitones, doing what the TR buttons do
Add expander (6HP right side) — places the CHD-X expander against the right edge of this module
